# Emmanuel Scale — Growth OS

> Emmanuel Oluwafemi (Emmanuel Scale) is a Shopify growth and conversion rate optimization (CRO) specialist who builds and scales ecommerce stores for dropshipping and DTC brands.

Emmanuel works with ecommerce founders and store owners on Shopify store builds, conversion optimization, paid advertising, email/retention systems, and technical troubleshooting. He also mentors clients on dropshipping strategy and Meta/Facebook ads.

## Services

- [Shopify Store Setup](https://emmanueloluwafemi456-boop.github.io/emmanuel-Scale/services/shopify-store-setup/) — Complete store build from scratch: theme customization, product setup, payment integration, and launch.
- [Custom Store Design](https://emmanueloluwafemi456-boop.github.io/emmanuel-Scale/services/custom-store-design/) — Conversion-optimized store design built around a brand's identity and audience.
- [Dropshipping Strategy](https://emmanueloluwafemi456-boop.github.io/emmanuel-Scale/services/dropshipping-strategy/) — Product research, supplier sourcing, and winning-product selection.
- [Paid Advertising](https://emmanueloluwafemi456-boop.github.io/emmanuel-Scale/services/paid-advertising/) — Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, and Google Ads campaign build and scaling.
- [CRO & Optimization](https://emmanueloluwafemi456-boop.github.io/emmanuel-Scale/services/cro-optimization/) — A/B testing, funnel optimization, and data-driven conversion improvements.
- [Email & Retention](https://emmanueloluwafemi456-boop.github.io/emmanuel-Scale/services/email-retention/) — Klaviyo flows, abandoned cart sequences, and retention strategy.
- [Shopify Bug & Technical Fixing](https://emmanueloluwafemi456-boop.github.io/emmanuel-Scale/services/shopify-technical-fixing/) — Diagnosing and resolving theme bugs, Liquid/JavaScript errors, app conflicts, and checkout issues.
- [SEO / GEO / AEO](https://emmanueloluwafemi456-boop.github.io/emmanuel-Scale/services/seo-geo-aeo/) — Search and AI-search visibility optimization for Shopify stores.
- [Analytics & Tracking](https://emmanueloluwafemi456-boop.github.io/emmanuel-Scale/services/analytics-tracking/) — GA4, Meta Pixel, and conversion tracking setup.

## Case studies

- [Zesto](https://emmanueloluwafemi456-boop.github.io/emmanuel-Scale/case-studies/zesto/) — Full-store Shopify experience designed around brand, product discovery, and conversion.
- [Alpino Foods](https://emmanueloluwafemi456-boop.github.io/emmanuel-Scale/case-studies/alpino/) — Conversion-focused product experience built around clarity, trust, offers, and purchase intent.
- [Shikō](https://emmanueloluwafemi456-boop.github.io/emmanuel-Scale/case-studies/shiko/) — Product-page optimization focused on purchase confidence and social proof.
- [Irritated](https://emmanueloluwafemi456-boop.github.io/emmanuel-Scale/case-studies/irritated/) — Before-and-after storefront transformation focused on positioning, mobile UX, and trust.
- [Lymphoria](https://emmanueloluwafemi456-boop.github.io/emmanuel-Scale/case-studies/lymphoria/) — Conversion optimization combining product presentation, offer architecture, and bundles.
- [Meta Ads](https://emmanueloluwafemi456-boop.github.io/emmanuel-Scale/case-studies/meta-ads/) — Paid acquisition and campaign optimization focused on efficient spend and return on ad spend.
- [Pet Store](https://emmanueloluwafemi456-boop.github.io/emmanuel-Scale/case-studies/pet-store/) — Campaign-level Meta Ads optimization identifying and scaling the highest-converting ad.
- [Aurelia](https://emmanueloluwafemi456-boop.github.io/emmanuel-Scale/case-studies/aurelia/) — Multi-stage funnel matching page type to awareness level.
- [Growth Analytics Dashboard](https://emmanueloluwafemi456-boop.github.io/emmanuel-Scale/case-studies/growth-analytics-dashboard/) — A connected dashboard pulling revenue, profit, ad spend, and ROAS from Shopify, Meta, and Google into one view.
